component.name: Pulse
component.summary: Live status of your home server

description.p: Pulse shows a server running the Pulse agent in real time: health score, CPU, temperature, memory, disk, network, fan, Docker containers and site checks. It sits in the tray and sends a desktop notification when something needs attention.
The agent is a small Go service you run on the server with Docker; Pulse talks to it over Tailscale with a token, nothing is exposed to the internet.
